一緒に映らなくなったことです。
綴理先輩と、乙宗先輩が。

en_hasuko.text:
When they stopped appearing together.
Tsuzuri-senpai and Otomune-senpai.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 사야카
ko_hasuko.text:
같이 찍히지 않게 된 거요.
츠즈리 선배랑, 오토무네 선배가.

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: Since then, I've never seen a picture of them together.

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: Ah...

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: Oh…

蓮ノ空女学院（学校）教室 夕

turns.textJp:
でも、じゃあきっと半年前に何かがあったんだよ！
それをどうにかできれば、センパイたちもーー。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
But then something must have happened half a year ago!
If we can do something about that, then our senpai can...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
그럼, 분명 반년 전에 무슨 일이 있었던 거야!
그걸 어떻게든 하면, 선배들도ーー.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: But wait, that means something definitely happened then! If we can do something to fix it, I'm sure they'll–

turns.textJp: 花帆さん。

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text: Kaho-san.

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: Kaho-san.

花帆.name: 花帆

花帆.motionDescription: 着座前に乗り出して固まる

turns.textJp:
そもそもこれは、先輩がたの記事を書くために始めたことです。
確かに、わたしだって気になりますけど。

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text:
To begin with, this started so we could write an article about our seniors.
It is true that I am curious too, but.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 사야카
ko_hasuko.text:
애초에 이건, 선배님들의 기사를 쓰기 위해 시작한 일이에요.
물론, 저도 궁금하지만요.

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: We only started looking into this to write an article about the second-years. I must admit I'm interested in this too, but…

background.comment: 蓮ノ空女学院（学校）教室 夕

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 着座前に乗り出して固まる

turns.textJp:
でも、ただの好奇心で踏み込んでいい問題とは、思えません。
記事のためのお話は、もう十分聞けましたから。

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text:
But I do not think this is a problem we can step into out of simple curiosity.
We have already heard enough for the article.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 사야카
ko_hasuko.text:
하지만, 단순한 호기심으로 파고들어도 될 문제라고는, 생각되지 않아요.
기사를 위한 이야기는, 이미 충분히 들었으니까요.

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: Even so, I don't think this is an issue we should insert ourselves in just out of sheer curiosity. We have more than enough for the article.

background.comment: 蓮ノ空女学院（学校）教室 夕

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 着座前に乗り出して固まる

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 着座前に乗り出して固まる

turns.textJp: それは……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: That's...

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: But…

background.comment: 蓮ノ空女学院（学校）教室 夕
蓮ノ空女学院（学校）教室 夕

turns.textJp:
ごめんなさい。
わたしだって同じですよ。

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text:
I am sorry.
I feel the same way.

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: I'm sorry. I feel the same way you do.

background.comment: 蓮ノ空女学院（学校）教室 夕
蓮ノ空女学院（学校）教室 夕

turns.textJp:
先輩がたの間に少しでも問題があるなら、
どうにかしてあげたいと思ってしまう。

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text:
If there is even a small problem between our seniors,
I find myself wanting to do something for them.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 사야카
ko_hasuko.text:
선배님들 사이에 조금이라도 문제가 있다면,
어떻게든 해드리고 싶다고 생각하게 돼요.

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: If there really is a problem between Otomune-senpai and Tsuzuri-senpai, I would want to do anything I could to solve it.

さやか.motionDescription: 着座胸に手を置く（両手）

turns.textJp: だからふたりで聞き込みもしたわけですしね。

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text: That is why the two of us asked around, after all.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 사야카
ko_hasuko.text: 그래서 둘이서 정보 수집도 한 거고요.

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: That's why we went and talked to both of them, after all.

turns.textJp:
でもこれ以上踏み込んで良いものかは……
わたしには分かりません。

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text:
But I do not know
whether it is all right for us to step any farther in.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 사야카
ko_hasuko.text:
하지만 이 이상 파고들어도 되는지는……
저는 잘 모르겠어요.

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: But as to whether we should step in, even more than we already have… even I don't know what to do.

turns.textJp: ……ねえ、さやかちゃん。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: ...Hey, Sayaka-chan.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: …Hey, Sayaka-chan.

turns.textJp:
さやかちゃんの言ってることは、分かってる。  正しいとも、思う。
でも、でもさ。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
I understand what you're saying. I think you're right too.
But, but still.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
사야카가 하는 말, 알고 있어. 옳다고도, 생각해.
하지만, 하지만 말이야.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: I understand where you're coming from. I even think you're right. It's just…

background.comment: 蓮ノ空女学院（学校）教室 夕
蓮ノ空女学院（学校）教室 夕

turns.textJp: あたしやっぱり、嫌だな。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: I really don't like this.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: I really don't like this.

turns.textJp: 花帆さん……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text: Kaho-san...

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: Kaho-san…

turns.textJp:
仲が良くてほっとしたよ？
梢センパイが綴理センパイから褒められて嬉しかった。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
I was relieved that they're close, you know?
I was happy that Kozue-senpai was praised by Tsuzuri-senpai.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
사이가 좋아서 안심했어.
코즈에 선배가 츠즈리 선배한테 칭찬받아서 기뻤어.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: It was such a relief to find out they get along well, wasn't it? It made me so happy to hear Tsuzuri-senpai speaking so highly of Kozue-senpai.

turns.textJp:
さやかちゃんからも、梢センパイが綴理センパイを好きって聞けて良かった。
でも、だったらなおさら嫌じゃない？

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
I was glad to hear from you too that Kozue-senpai likes Tsuzuri-senpai.
But if that's true, doesn't that make it even worse?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
사야카한테서, 코즈에 선배가 츠즈리 선배를 좋아한다고 들어서 좋았어.
하지만, 그렇다면 더더욱 싫지 않아?

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: I'm sure you felt the same when Kozue-senpai mentioned that she liked Tsuzuri-senpai. But doesn't that just make you hate this situation even more?

en_hasuko.text:
If you ask whether I dislike it or not, I dislike it too.
But...

싫으냐, 싫지 않으냐로 따지면 저도 싫어요.
하지만…….

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka

あたし、綴理センパイの寂しそうな顔見ちゃったよ。
梢センパイだって、絶対今のままが嬉しいなんて思ってないじゃん。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
I saw Tsuzuri-senpai's lonely face.
And there's no way Kozue-senpai is happy with things the way they are now.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
나, 츠즈리 선배의 쓸쓸한 얼굴을 봐 버렸어.
코즈에 선배도, 절대 지금 이대로가 기쁘다고 생각하지 않잖아.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: I saw how sad Tsuzuri-senpai looked earlier. And I'm completely sure Kozue-senpai also isn't happy with the way things are.
